propositions: Merge-abort recovery logic is duplicated across sync.reconverge and push_recovery, causing maintenance divergence and repeated bugs like small-delicious-loris and sulfuryl-suicidal-osprey
push_recovery._quarantine_untracked_paths checks for untracked status (git ??) before moving files, but sync._quarantine_untracked and doctor._quarantine_leftovers lack this safety fence
The quarantine mover and merge-abort parser toolkit must be unified in a neutral owner module (merge_recovery.py) that accepts git as a callable to support both module-level and late-bound git seams
sync.py and push_recovery.py must maintain their current public signatures through delegating adapters to preserve existing monkeypatch sites and test bindings
Consolidation must converge the safety fence so all callers refuse to move tracked files, ensuring no regression in existing behavior
